name: Aqua
rootCause: On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported that the Solana project Aqua has likely executed a rug pull involving approximately 21,770 SOL (~$4.65M). A few hours ago, the funds were split into four parts, moved through multiple intermediary addresses, and then sent to various instant exchanges.
